reasons.action: No new action, behavior, vocal performance or other requested performance is specified; the reference action/pose remains authoritative.
reasons.medium: The medium decision preserves the observed live-action rendering; no restyling or rendering-family change was requested.
reasons.wardrobe: No clothing or accessory change is requested. The car-body material and wheel sourcing are handled as target identity/properties by identity_requirements, not as wardrobe, so no wardrobe request overrides the reference.
reasons.lighting: No light source, direction, quality or other lighting instruction is given; reference lighting is retained.
reasons.framing: No camera composition, shot scale, viewpoint or camera movement is requested. The 16:9 aspect is only a canvas ratio, so reference framing governs.
reasons.palette: No hue, color grade, saturation or tonal-contrast instruction is given; the reference palette is retained.
